function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check salon availability for one service and local start time. Does not book. Time fields use ISO-8601 with explicit UTC offset plus IANA timeZone.

service.description: Service ID from salon policy, e.g. cut_and_style, color_consultation, blowout.

startDateTime.description: Requested local start, ISO-8601 with explicit UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-26T10:00:00-07:00.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for interpretation, e.g. America/Los_Angeles.
